# Libraries

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
```

# Load data

```{r}
clim <- read.table(here("data", "clim.txt"), header = TRUE, sep = " ")
```

# Data management

### Filter data

```{r}
filtered_clim <- clim |>
  filter(month %in% c(1, 2)) |>
  select(-wy, -tmax_c)
```

### Create data for total precipitation calculation

```{r}
jan_precip_summary <- filtered_clim |>
  filter(month == 1) |>
  group_by(year) |>
  summarise(jan_precip = sum(precip, na.rm = TRUE), 
            .groups = "drop")
```

### Create data for average minimum temperature calculation

```{r}
feb_TminC_summary <- filtered_clim |>
  filter(month == 2) |>
  group_by(year) |>
  summarise(feb_tmin_c = mean(tmin_c, na.rm = TRUE), 
            .groups = "drop")
```

### Join the two summaries

```{r}
clim_inputs <- left_join(feb_TminC_summary, jan_precip_summary, by = "year")
```

# Calculate almond yield anomaly for each year

```{r}
source("R/almond_yield.R")

clim_yield_summary <- clim_inputs |>
  mutate(yield_anomaly = almond_yield(min_temp = feb_tmin_c, 
                                      P = jan_precip))
```

# Plot of almond yield anomaly over time

```{r}
ggplot(clim_yield_summary, aes(x = year, y = yield_anomaly)) +
  geom_line(color = "darkgreen", size = 1) +
  geom_point(color = "darkgreen", size = 2) +
  labs(title = "Yield Anomaly Over Time", x = "Year", 
       y = "Yield Anomaly (tons/acre)") + 
  theme_bw()
```
